fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ file tipo 1 - data generales del contributor(34 campos, 567 posiciones) ═══

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Nombre o razon social del aportante
fields.Format: A(200) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Registered name of the contributing employer. Supplied by the contributor and echoed into File Tipo 2 Record Tipo 1 campo 4, where the annex says expressly 'El registrado en el campo 1 del file tipo 1' - the two must be byte-identical.

fields.Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Identity-document type of the employer, from the closed list NI, CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, SC, PE, PT (PT = Permiso por Protección Temporal). PE may not be used for health contribution periods from September 2023 onwards. For a corporate employer it is always NI (tax identification number). Echoed into T2R1 campo 5. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §1.1 campo 2.

fields.Format: A(16) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: The employer's identification number. The information operator validates that it contains only A-Z and 0-9. An ALPHANUMERIC number is permitted ONLY for PA (passport, up to 16) and CD (carne diplomatico, up to 11). All other types are digits only: TI up to 11, CC up to 10, NI up to 11, SC up to 8, CE up to 7, PE exactly 15, PT up to 8, PC (PEP-Tutor) up to 8. Echoed into T2R1 campo 6. Same number as Form 350 casilla 5 and electronic payroll NIE033. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §1.1 campo 3.

fields.Conditional Reason: MANDATORY where 'Employer person type' (A1-009) = J (Juridica); for every other case the field must be ZERO. Bidirectional pair with A1-009.
fields.Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: DIAN check digit of the employer NIT. The annex requires the information operator to validate it against the DIAN algorithm. Echoed into T2R1 campo 7.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Codigo de la sucursal o de la dependencia
fields.Conditional Reason: MUST BE BLANK where 'Form of presentation' (A1-010) = U (Unico). Populated only where A1-010 = S (Sucursal). Bidirectional pair with A1-010 and with 'Branch name' (A1-006).
fields.Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Code of the branch or dependency filing this return. Echoed into T2R1 campo 12. A multi-branch employer files one return per branch under S; a single consolidated return uses U and leaves this blank.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Nombre de la sucursal o de la dependencia
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated together with 'Branch or dependency code' (A1-005). The annex directs that where the branch has no name, the branch CODE is written here instead.
fields.Format: A(40) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Name of the branch. Echoed into T2R1 campo 13. Where the branch is unnamed, repeat the code from A1-005 rather than leaving it blank.

fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: A = 200 or more contributors; B = fewer than 200; C = Mipyme electing the Law 590 of 2000 parafiscal discounts; D = beneficiary of the Law 1429 of 2010 formalisation regime; I = Independiente (a natural person paying their own or their dependants' contributions - not used by a corporate employer). The headcount test for A and B counts contributors across ALL branches. For class C the information operator must verify MONTHLY that the employer appears in the file DIAN sends the Ministry under Decree 525 of 2009 art. 6 - so the class cannot simply be asserted. Bidirectional set with 'Commercial registry date' (A1-031) and 'Department code (registered seat)' (A1-032), both of which become mandatory where this field = D, the Law 1429 of 2010 formalisation beneficiary. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §1.1 campo 7 and §1.2.1.

fields.Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: 1 Publica, 2 Privada, 3 Mixta, 4 Organismos multilaterales, 5 Entidades de derecho publico no sometidas a la legislacion colombiana. Private-sector corporate payroll is 2.

fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: N Natural or J Juridica. Where N, the valid document types in A1-002 narrow to CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, PE, SC and PT - NI is not available to a natural person. Where J, the verification digit (A1-004) and the whole legal-representative block (A1-018 to A1-024) become mandatory. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §1.1 campo 9.

fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: U Unico or S Sucursal. Determines whether the branch code and name (A1-005, A1-006) are filled or blank. Echoed into T2R1 campo 11.

fields.Format: A(40) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Postal address of the employer for correspondence from the subsystem administrators.

fields.Format: A(3) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: THREE-digit DANE DIVIPOLA municipality code - note that this is the municipality suffix ALONE, not the five-digit code used by the electronic payroll. Bogota D.C. is 001 here and 11001 there. Left BLANK where the 'Colombiano en el exterior' flag is marked.

fields.Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Two-digit DANE DIVIPOLA department code. Concatenated with A1-012 it reconstructs the five-digit code used elsewhere: 11 + 001 = 11001, Bogota D.C.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Codigo DANE de la actividad economica
fields.Format: N(4) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Four-digit economic activity from the CIIU revision 4 adapted for Colombia, issued by DANE through Resolution 549 of 2020 or the norm that modifies or replaces it. The SAME classification drives the DIAN self-withholding rate in Form 350 casilla 27; keep one code, consumed twice. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §1.1 campo 14.

fields.Format: N(10) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Contact telephone of the employer. Mandatory in the annex even though it plays no part in the settlement.

fields.Format: N(10) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Fax number. Optional and, in practice, obsolete - but the ten positions remain reserved in the record and must be zero-filled if unused, because the field is typed N.

fields.Format: A(60) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Employer e-mail. The annex prescribes the validation in detail: the local part may contain a-z, 0-9, hyphen, underscore, apostrophe and full stop; the separator must be the @ character; the domain may contain a-z, 0-9 and hyphen, and the hyphen may be neither the first nor the last character of the domain.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Numero de identificacion del representante legal
fields.Conditional Reason: MANDATORY where 'Employer person type' (A1-009) = J (Juridica); OPTIONAL where A1-009 = N (Natural). Bidirectional pair with A1-009 and with the legal-representative block A1-019 to A1-024.
fields.Format: A(16) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Identity number of the legal representative. The operador validates that it contains only A-Z and 0-9. An alphanumeric value is permitted only for document types PA and CD; for CC and CE it must be all digits.

fields.Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: The annex is explicit and counter-intuitive here: 'Este campo se debera reportar en cero'. It is ALWAYS zero, whatever the representative's document. Do not compute a check digit. Bidirectional pair with 'Legal representative identification number' (A1-018): the operador validates this digit against the number carried in A1-018.

fields.Conditional Reason: MANDATORY where 'Employer person type' (A1-009) = J; optional where A1-009 = N. Bidirectional pair with A1-009 and A1-018.
fields.Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Closed list of only four values: CC Citizenship ID card, CE Foreign resident ID card, PA Passport, CD Carne diplomatico. Narrower than the employer's own document-type list in A1-002 - NI, TI, SC and PE are not available for a legal representative.

fields.Conditional Reason: MANDATORY where 'Employer person type' (A1-009) = J. Bidirectional pair with A1-009.
fields.Format: A(20) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: First surname of the legal representative.

fields.Format: A(30) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Second surname. Supplied by the contributor; not mandatory even for a legal person, which accommodates a representative with a single surname - unlike the electronic payroll, where the employee's second surname is use=required (CO-GAP-07).

fields.Conditional Reason: MANDATORY where 'Employer person type' (A1-009) = J. Bidirectional pair with A1-009.
fields.Format: A(20) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: First given name of the legal representative.

fields.Format: A(30) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Second given name. Optional. Part of the bidirectional legal-representative name set governed by 'Legal representative identification number' (A1-018) and 'Employer person type' (A1-009).

fields.Field Name (EN): Insolvency, restructuring, liquidation or cessation start date
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Fecha de inicio del concordato, reestructuracion, liquidacion o cese de actividades
fields.Conditional Reason: Optional in general, but MANDATORY where 'Type of action' (A1-026) is populated. Bidirectional pair with A1-026: the annex says 'Es mandatory cuando se diligencia information en el campo 26 de este file'.
fields.Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Date from which the concordato, restructuring, liquidation or cessation of activities takes effect. Format AAAA-MM-DD. Used where there is no payroll and no payment.

fields.Conditional Reason: Optional. Where populated, it makes 'Insolvency start date' (A1-025) mandatory and 'Commercial-activity cessation date' (A1-027) required. Bidirectional set with A1-025 and A1-027.
fields.Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: 0 No aplica, 1 Concordato, 2 Reestructuracion, 3 Liquidacion, 4 Cese de actividades. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §1.1 campo 26.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Fecha en que termino actividades comerciales
fields.Conditional Reason: Optional in general; the annex directs that it 'se debe diligenciar cuando se ha reportado information en el campo 26 de este record'. Bidirectional pair with A1-026.
fields.Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Date from which the employer is no longer obliged to make contributions. Format AAAA-MM-DD. This is the field that stops the obligation - not the mere absence of employees.

fields.Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Assigned by the system of the licensed information operator, not by the employer. Colombia's social-security filing is intermediated: THE EMPLOYER NEVER TRANSACTS DIRECTLY WITH THE GOVERNMENT for contributions.

fields.Format: N(7) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Assigned by the system. Format AAAA-MM, seven positions. The contribution period, not the payment date.
fields.Query to RA: TYPE / FORMAT CONFLICT IN THE OFFICIAL ANNEX, recorded. The layout table types this field as N (numeric, zero-filled) yet prescribes the format AAAA-MM, which occupies all seven positions only if it contains a hyphen - a non-numeric character. The equivalent header fields T2R1-015 and T2R1-016 are typed A for the same format. Confirm with the RA and with the chosen operador whether A1-029 is written as '2026-03' (hyphenated, as the format implies) or as '0202603' / '2026003' (some other seven-digit numeric form).

fields.Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Seventeen-value list: 1 Empleador, 2 Independiente, 3 Entidades o universidades publicas de regimenes especial y de excepcion, 4 Agremiaciones/asociaciones/congregaciones religiosas, 5 Cooperativas y precooperativas de trabajo asociado, 6 Misiones diplomaticas/consulares/organismos multilaterales, 7 Organizaciones Administradoras del Programa de Hogares de Bienestar, 8 Pagador de concejales y ediles, 9 Pagador contrato sindical, 10 Pagador programa de reincorporacion, 11 Pagador aportes parafiscales del Magisterio, 12 Pagador prestacion humanitaria, 13 Pagador Subsistema Nacional de Voluntarios en Primera Respuesta, 14 Trabajador pago aporte faltante pension, 15 Contratante, 16 Pagador Promotor del Servicio Social para la Paz, 17 Pagador Recicladores de Oficio. Private corporate payroll is 1. Echoed into T2R1 campo 21, where the annex requires equality. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §1.1 campo 30 and §1.2.4.

fields.Conditional Reason: MANDATORY for an employer benefiting from the Ley 1429 de 2010 formalisation regime - i.e. where 'Class of contributor' (A1-007) = D or 'Ley 1429 CCF benefit' (A1-034) = S. Bidirectional set with A1-007, A1-032 and A1-034.
fields.Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Date of the commercial registry of the employer's principal seat. The annex restricts the admissible range to 29 December 2010 through 31 December 2014 - the Ley 1429 window. A date outside that range is rejected.

fields.Conditional Reason: MANDATORY for a Ley 1429 de 2010 beneficiary. Bidirectional set with A1-007, A1-031 and A1-034.
fields.Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: DIVIPOLA department of the employer's principal domicile, as distinct from A1-013 which is the correspondence department. For most employers the two coincide.

fields.Field Name (EN): Employer exonerated from health, SENA and ICBF contributions
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Aportante exonerado de pago de aporte a salud, SENA e ICBF
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: S or N. THE SINGLE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL FLAG IN THE EMPLOYER RECORD. It declares that the employer is exonerated under ET art. 114-1 from the EMPLOYER health contribution of 8.5%, from the SENA levy of 2% and from the ICBF levy of 3%, for employees earning less than 10 SMMLV (COP 17,509,050 in 2026). It does NOT touch pension, occupational risk or the family compensation fund 4%, none of which is ever exonerated. The per-employee side of the same test is Record Tipo 2 campo 76, and the DIAN side is Form 350 casilla 27 - configure the test once and consume it in all three places. Bidirectional set with the Record Tipo 2 exoneration fields: 'Contributor exonerated from payment' (T2R2-076), and the SENA and ICBF rate fields (T2R2-066 and T2R2-068) which must be ZERO wherever the ET art. 114-1 exoneration reaches the individual employee.

fields.Field Name (EN): Employer electing Ley 1429 art. 5 benefits for the family compensation fund
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Aportante que se acoge a los beneficios del articulo 5 de la Ley 1429 de 2010 con respecto al aporte para las cajas de compensacion familiar
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: S or N. Declares that the employer claims the Ley 1429 de 2010 art. 5 progressive relief on the 4% family-compensation-fund contribution. Distinct from the art. 114-1 exoneration in A1-033: the CCF 4% is NEVER exonerated under art. 114-1, so this is the only route to relief on it. Bidirectional set with A1-007 (class D), A1-031 and A1-032.

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ file tipo 2, record tipo 1 - encabezado(22 campos, 359 posiciones) ═══

fields.Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: A CONSTANT. Must be 01 for the header record of File Tipo 2. The detail records that follow carry 02 in the same two positions, which is how a parser distinguishes them.

fields.Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: 1 Electronica - the employer keys or uploads the settlement on the operador's web site; 2 Asistida - the employer telephones the operador's call centre and the operador keys it. The annex adds that where Decree 780 of 2016 art. 3.2.3.9 para. 2 exceptionally allows assisted payment, the field must still say ELECTRONICA, and the operador reports those employers separately to the Ministry through SISPRO structure PUB019EXPE by the fifth business day of the following month.

fields.Format: N(4) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Header sequence number within the file.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Nombre o razon social del aportante
fields.Format: A(200) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Must be identical to File Tipo 1 campo 1 - the annex says 'El registrado en el campo 1 del file tipo 1'. Any divergence between the two files is a validation failure at the operador, not at the Ministry.

fields.Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Must equal File Tipo 1 campo 2.

fields.Format: A(16) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Must equal File Tipo 1 campo 3. The LAST TWO DIGITS of this number determine the PILA filing deadline - the 2nd to 16th business day of the following month - which is a different rule from Form 350, where only the LAST digit matters.

fields.Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Must equal File Tipo 1 campo 4.

fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Single letter selecting the settlement type. E Employee return is the ordinary monthly employer return. The full list also carries Y (independientes empresas), A (cotizantes con novedad de ingreso), I (independientes), S (servicio domestico), M (mora), N (correcciones), H (madres sustitutas), T and F (Sistema General de Participaciones - DESCOPED, public sector only), J (sentencia judicial), X (empresa liquidada), U (uso UGPP pago por terceros), K (estudiantes), O (obligaciones determinadas por la UGPP), Q (acuerdos de pago UGPP / ordenes de pago en proceso especial), B (Piso de Proteccion Social), D (Contribucion Solidaria), Z (pago de calculo actuarial por omision en pensiones) and W (reliquidaciones por retroactivo servidores publicos). Types I and Y are descoped in scope_manifest - the contribution base for an independent worker is 40% of fees, not salary. Bidirectional set with 'Associated return number' (T2R1-009) and 'Associated return payment date' (T2R1-010), whose population depends on this type (see their conditional rules), and with the 'Corrections' change event (T2R2-022). Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.1.1 campo 8.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Numero de la planilla asociada a esta planilla
fields.Conditional Reason: MUST BE BLANK where 'Return type' (T2R1-008) is E, A, I, M, S, Y, H, T, X, K, Q or B. Populated with the number of the period return where the type is N, F or W; for U the UGPP enters the judicial deposit title number; for J (court order on omitted salary factors) the number of the return with which the original payment was made; for O the number of the return that produced the UGPP inexactitud; for Z the payment reference issued by www.soyactuario.com.co. Bidirectional pair with T2R1-008 and with 'Associated return payment date' (T2R1-010).
fields.Format: N(10) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: The return number this settlement relates back to. It is what turns a correction (N), an SGP employer top-up (F) or a public-servant retroactive reliquidation (W) into an amendment of a specific earlier filing rather than a new one. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.1.1 campo 9.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Fecha de pago Planilla asociada a esta planilla. (AAAA-MM-DD)
fields.Conditional Reason: MUST BE BLANK where 'Return type' (T2R1-008) is E, A, I, M, S, Y, T, X, K, H, Q or B. Populated with the payment date of the period return where the type is N or F; for U the date the judicial deposit was constituted; for J and O the payment date of the original return; for W the date the entity paid the retroactive salary. Bidirectional pair with 'Associated return number' (T2R1-009).
fields.Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Payment date of the associated return, format AAAA-MM-DD. For return type U the UGPP enters the date the judicial deposit was constituted; for W, the date the public entity paid the retroactive salary. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.1.1 campo 10.

fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Must equal File Tipo 1 campo 10. Bidirectional pair with 'Branch code' (T2R1-012), which is blank where this field = U (Unico) and populated where it = S (Sucursal).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Codigo de la sucursal del aportante
fields.Conditional Reason: Must equal File Tipo 1 campo 5, and is therefore blank where 'Form of presentation' (T2R1-011) = U. Bidirectional pair with T2R1-011. Also bidirectional with 'Branch name' (T2R1-013), which is populated together with this code.
fields.Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Branch code, echoed from File Tipo 1.

fields.Conditional Reason: Must equal File Tipo 1 campo 6; populated together with 'Branch code' (T2R1-012).
fields.Format: A(40) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Branch name, echoed from File Tipo 1.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Codigo de la ARL a la cual el aportante se encuentra afiliado
fields.Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right. Prefix pattern ^(ARL|EPS|EOC|AFP|CCF|FSP)[0-9]{3}$ - THREE alphabetic positions identifying the subsystem followed by THREE numeric positions identifying the administradora. Verified against the PILA anexo, which names FSP001, MIN001 and MIN002 in running prose. The code LIST itself is master data published by the Ministerio de Salud y Proteccion Social; validate the prefix here and the code against the catalogue
fields.Field Explanation: Code of the occupational-risk insurer (Occupational-risk insurer (ARL)) to which the EMPLOYER is affiliated. The employer has one ARL; the per-employee ARL in Record Tipo 2 campo 77 normally matches it, but the RISK CLASS varies by work centre, not by employer.

fields.Field Name (EN): Payment period for subsystems other than health
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Periodo de pago para los sistemas
fields.Format: A(7) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Format AAAA-MM, CALCULATED BY THE OPERADOR, not supplied by the employer. Covers pension, occupational risk and the parafiscal levies.

fields.Field Name (EN): Payment period for the health subsystem
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Periodo de pago para el sistema de salud.
fields.Format: A(7) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Format AAAA-MM, SUPPLIED BY THE EMPLOYER. COLOMBIA'S MOST-MISSED PILA RULE: health is paid ONE MONTH IN ADVANCE, so the health period is normally the month AFTER the period in T2R1-015. A settlement for March salaries carries pension period 2026-03 and health period 2026-04. Getting these equal is the classic first-run defect.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Numero de radicacion o de la Planilla Integrada de Liquidacion de Aportes.
fields.Format: N(10) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Assigned by the operador's system and unique per operador. This is the number the employer quotes in any later correction, and the number the inbound settlement response returns.

fields.Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Assigned by the system from the effective payment date, format AAAA-MM-DD. Where it falls after the statutory deadline the operador computes interest on arrears and the return becomes a mora settlement.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Numero total de cotizantes reportados en esta planilla.
fields.Format: N(5) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Must equal the number of UNIQUE contributors in the Record Tipo 2 detail, EXCLUDING those whose 'Tipo contributor' (T2R2-005) is 40 - Beneficiary UPC Adicional. That exclusion is easy to miss and produces a header-to-detail mismatch that the operador rejects. Bidirectional pair with 'Additional UPC value' (T2R2-056): contributor type 40 records are precisely the records that carry that value and that are excluded from this count.

fields.Format: N(12) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: The sum of the values reported in campo 45 'IBC CCF' of Record Tipo 2 for every contributor type other than independents. Where the contributor types in the return are not obliged to contribute to a family compensation fund, the value is ZERO. It is NOT the parafiscal base in campo 95. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.1.1 campo 20.
fields.Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decree 1990 of 2016 art. 1).

fields.Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Mandatory and must be EQUAL to File Tipo 1 campo 30. The annex states the equality expressly.

fields.Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Assigned by the operador's system. Same value as File Tipo 1 campo 28.

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ file tipo 2, record tipo 2 - detailed settlement(98 campos, 693 posiciones) ═══

fields.Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: A CONSTANT. Must be 02 for a detail record. Distinguishes it from the 01 header in the same file.

fields.Format: N(5) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Must start at 00001 and be strictly sequential for the remaining detail records in the file.

fields.Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Closed list CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, SC, RC, PE, PT (PT = Permiso por Protección Temporal). PE may not be used for health contribution periods from September 2023 onwards. An ALPHANUMERIC identification number is permitted only for PA and CD; for TI, CC, SC, RC, CE, PE and PT the number must be all digits. NOTE the divergence from the electronic payroll, which uses NUMERIC codes (13 = CC) rather than these two-letter codes - the engine must MAP, not copy. Bidirectional set with 'Foreign national not liable to contribute to pension' (T2R2-007), which where marked restricts this field to CE, PA, CD, SC, PE or PT, and with 'Colombian abroad' (T2R2-008), which is used only where this field is CC or TI. COMPOSITE KEY: together with T2R2-004 (Contributor identification number), this pair is the join key for the contributor across every Colombian artefact -- electronic payroll NIE044/NIE045, Form 220 casillas 24/25, Format 2276 numeral 2 -- matching the same pair convention documented on CO-SEVERANCE SAVINGS-006 T03/T04. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.2.1 campos 3, 7 and 8.

fields.Format: A(16) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Identity number of the contributor. Only A-Z and 0-9; alphanumeric only for PA (up to 16) and CD (up to 11). Digits only for the rest: TI up to 11, CC up to 10, SC up to 8, RC up to 11, CE up to 7, PE exactly 15, PT up to 8, PC (PEP-Tutor) up to 16. Join key to the electronic payroll NIE045, to Form 220 casilla 25 and to Format 2276 numeral 2. COMPOSITE KEY: together with T2R2-003 (Contributor document type), this pair is the join key for the contributor -- see T2R2-003 for the full cross-reference list. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.2.1 campo 4.

fields.Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: The full PILA tipo cotizante list - far longer than the values the electronic payroll recognises. Values: 1 Dependiente, 2 Servicio domestico, 3 Independiente, 4 Madre sustituta, 12 Aprendices en etapa lectiva (ONLY for health contribution periods BEFORE August 2025), 16, 18, 19 Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025 (from the health period of August 2025: contributes to health and occupational risk only, IBC 1 SMMLV, no pension, CCF, SENA or ICBF; the operador validates the apprentice against the SENA 'REPORTE DE APRENDICES' file), 20 to 23, 30 to 36, 40 Beneficiario UPC Adicional, 42 to 45, 47, 51 to 63, 64 Trabajador penitenciario o servicio de utilidad publica, 65 Dependiente vinculado al Piso de Proteccion Social, 66 Independiente vinculado al Piso de Proteccion Social, 67 Voluntario en Primera Respuesta, 68 Dependiente veterano de la Fuerza Publica, 69 Contribuyente solidario, 70 Promotor del Servicio Social para la Paz, 71 Ley de Segundas Oportunidades, 72 Mujeres con aporte a pension por pago por tercero, 73 Interno de Medicina, 74 Reciclador de Oficio, 75 Dependiente con permanencia en el Regimen Subsidiado, 76 Trabajador de tiempo parcial independiente. Codes 3, 16, 20, 32 to 45, 52, 53, 55, 57 and 59 onwards have NO electronic payroll equivalent, so a direct copy will fail DIAN validation. Type 40 is additionally excluded from the header count in T2R1-019. Bidirectional set with the fields this code gates: 'Work location department code' (T2R2-009) and 'Work location municipality code' (T2R2-010) are blank for type 40; 'Additional UPC value' (T2R2-056) is populated for type 40 and type 69; 'Principal contributor document type' (T2R2-074) only for type 40; 'Hours worked' (T2R2-096) is optional for types 1, 2, 18, 22, 30, 51 and 55; 'Hire date' (T2R2-080) is mandatory for type 75; and 'Pension fund of the member' (T2R2-031) may be blank only for a type not obliged to contribute to pension. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.2.1 campo 5 and §2.1.2.3.1.
fields.Query to RA: AT2 v30 assigns code 19 to apprentices in the LECTIVA phase under Ley 2466 de 2025 (from health period August 2025) and restricts code 12 to earlier periods. The annex does not name a code for apprentices in the PRODUCTIVE phase after August 2025. Confirm with the client's operador which tipo cotizante the operador accepts for productive-phase apprentices before configuring them.

fields.Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.Field Explanation: Twelve-value list: 0 No aplica, 1 Dependiente pensioner por vejez/jubilacion/invalidez activo, 2 Independiente pensioner, 3 Not required to contribute to pension por edad, 4 Requisitos cumplidos para pension, 5 Indemnizacion sustitutiva o devolucion de saldos reconocida, 6 Regimen exceptuado de pensiones, 9 Pensioner con mesada >= 25 SMLMV, 10 Residente en el exterior affiliate voluntario, 11 and 12 Conductores de taxi. HARD RULE printed in the annex: where the sub-type is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9 or 12, campo 46 (pension contribution rate) MUST be 0. Only sub-types 0 and 1 have a electronic payroll equivalent. Bidirectional pair with 'Pension fund of the member' (T2R2-031), which may be blank only where this sub-type is one not obliged to contribute to the Sistema General de Pensiones.

fields.Field Name (EN): Foreign national not liable to contribute to pensions
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Extranjero no obligado a cotizar a pensiones
fields.Conditional Reason: Blank or X. Where marked, the ONLY valid document types in 'Contributor document type' (T2R2-003) are CE, PA, CD, SC and PE. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-003.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Marks a foreign employee who proves affiliation to a pension system abroad and elects out of Colombian pension affiliation under Decree 1072 of 2015 art. 2.2.1.2.1.4. Health, occupational risk and the parafiscal levies remain fully payable - only pension is waived.

fields.Conditional Reason: Blank or X. Used only where 'Contributor document type' (T2R2-003) is CC or TI. Where marked, the work-location department and municipality (T2R2-009 and T2R2-010) must be left BLANK. Bidirectional set with T2R2-003, T2R2-009 and T2R2-010. Also bidirectional with 'Date of filing abroad' (T2R2-097), which is populated only where this flag is marked.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Marks a Colombian national contributing from abroad. Its practical effect on this record is to suppress the DIVIPOLA work-location fields, which have no meaning outside Colombia.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Codigo del departamento de la ubicacion laboral
fields.Conditional Reason: Left BLANK where 'Colombian abroad' (T2R2-008) is marked, and where 'Contributor type' (T2R2-005) = 40 (Beneficiary UPC Adicional). Bidirectional set with T2R2-008 and T2R2-005. Also bidirectional with 'Work location municipality code' (T2R2-010), which is left blank in the same two cases.
fields.Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: DIVIPOLA department where the work is performed. The operador validates it against the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue. Should reconcile to electronic payroll NIE051.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Codigo del municipio de ubicacion laboral
fields.Conditional Reason: Left BLANK in the same two cases as 'Work location department code' (T2R2-009) - 'Colombian abroad' marked, or contributor type 40. Bidirectional set with T2R2-008 and T2R2-005.
fields.Format: A(3) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: THREE-digit DIVIPOLA municipality suffix - not the five-digit code used by the electronic payroll. Concatenate with T2R2-009 to obtain the five-digit form: 11 + 001 = 11001. Should reconcile to NIE052.

fields.Format: A(20) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: First surname of the contributor. Mandatory.

fields.Format: A(30) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Second surname. NOT mandatory here - a material contrast with the electronic payroll, where SegundoApellido is use=required and a single-surname employee forces a placeholder (CO-GAP-07). The same employee can therefore be reported correctly in PILA and imperfectly in the XML.

fields.Format: A(20) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: First given name. Mandatory.

fields.Format: A(30) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.Field Explanation: Second given name. Optional.

fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, R, X or C. Where marked, 'Hire date' (T2R2-080) becomes mandatory.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_ING [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: Marks the employee's entry into the contribution system in this period. Drives the proportional day counts in campos 36 to 39 and pairs with the hire date in campo 80.

fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, P, R, X or C. Where marked, 'Termination date' (T2R2-081) becomes mandatory.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_RET [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: Marks the employee's exit. Pairs with the termination date in campo 81 and reduces the contributory days in campos 36 to 39.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): TDE: Traslado desde otra EPS o EOC
fields.Conditional Reason: Must be reported BLANK. AT2 v30 no longer accepts transfer events in this field ('Debe reportarse en blanco'); EPS and pension-fund transfers are not reported through PILA.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_TDE [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: Transfer INTO the reported health insurer from another EPS or EOC.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): TAE: Traslado a otra EPS o EOC
fields.Conditional Reason: Must be reported BLANK. AT2 v30 no longer accepts transfer events in this field ('Debe reportarse en blanco'); EPS and pension-fund transfers are not reported through PILA.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_TAE [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: Transfer OUT to another health insurer. The destination EPS code goes in campo 34.

fields.Field Name (EN): TDP - transfer from another pension administrator
fields.Field Name (Local ES): TDP: Traslado desde otra administradora de pensiones
fields.Conditional Reason: Must be reported BLANK. AT2 v30 no longer accepts transfer events in this field ('Debe reportarse en blanco'); EPS and pension-fund transfers are not reported through PILA.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_TDP [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: Transfer INTO the reported pension administrator.

fields.Field Name (EN): TAP - transfer to another pension administrator
fields.Field Name (Local ES): TAP: Traslado a otra administradora de pensiones
fields.Conditional Reason: Must be reported BLANK. AT2 v30 no longer accepts transfer events in this field ('Debe reportarse en blanco'); EPS and pension-fund transfers are not reported through PILA.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_TAP [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: Transfer OUT to another pension administrator. Colombia permits a regime change every five years, so this is a recurring event, not an exception.

fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Where marked, 'VSP start date' (T2R2-082) becomes mandatory. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-082.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_VSP [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: A permanent change in salary taking effect during the period. Distinct from VST (campo 23), which is transitory. The distinction matters: a permanent variation resets the contribution base going forward, a transitory one does not.

fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, A or C. Used with return type N in 'Return type' (T2R1-008). Bidirectional pair with T2R1-008.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_Correccion [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: A adds a contributor omitted from the original return; C corrects a contributor already reported. Only meaningful on a correction return.

fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_VST [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: A one-off variation in the contribution base for this period only - typically a bonus or a retroactive payment - that does not change the standing salary.

fields.Field Name (EN): SLN - contract suspension or unpaid leave
fields.Field Name (Local ES): SLN: Suspension temporal del contrato de trabajo o licencia no remunerada o comision de servicios
fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, X or C. Where marked, 'SLN start date' (T2R2-083) and 'SLN end date' (T2R2-084) become mandatory. Bidirectional set with T2R2-083 and T2R2-084.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_SLN [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: Temporary suspension of the contract, unpaid leave, or a commission of service. Reduces the contributory days in campos 36 to 39 and must reconcile to the electronic payroll LicenciaNR block (NIE136 to NIE138).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): IGE: Incapacidad temporal por enfermedad general.
fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. Blank, X or L. Where marked, 'IGE start date' (T2R2-085) and 'IGE end date' (T2R2-086) may be reported (optional). Campos 57 and 58 are always blank / zero under AT2 v30. Bidirectional set with T2R2-085 and T2R2-086.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_IGE [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: IGE: incapacidad temporal por enfermedad general o licencia por cuidado de la ninez. X = general-illness incapacity in the period (the employer bears days 1-2 and the EPS funds from day 3; maps to electronic payroll Incapacidad Tipo = 1, Comun). L = licencia por cuidado de la ninez. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.2.1 campo 25 and §2.1.2.3.42.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): LMA: Licencia de Maternidad o de paternidad.
fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. Blank, X or P. Where marked, 'LMA start date' (T2R2-087) and 'LMA end date' (T2R2-088) may be reported (optional). Campos 59 and 60 are always blank / zero under AT2 v30. Bidirectional set with T2R2-087 and T2R2-088.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_LMA [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: LMA: licencia de maternidad o de paternidad. X = the contributor is on maternity or paternity leave in the period (no occupational-risk contribution for those days, Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6). P = licencia parental flexible de tiempo parcial (CST art. 236 par. 5, as modified by Ley 2114 de 2021): occupational risk IS contributed for the time worked; the X portion goes on a separate line, total days in the period cannot exceed 30 and the summed IBC cannot be below 1 SMMLV. Maps to the electronic payroll LicenciaMP block (NIE128 to NIE131). Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.2.1 campo 26 and §2.1.2.3.41.

fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are X (vacaciones), L (paid leave) or blank. Where marked, 'VAC-LR start date' (T2R2-089) and 'VAC-LR end date' (T2R2-090) become mandatory. Bidirectional set with T2R2-089 and T2R2-090.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_VAC_LR [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: A THREE-VALUE flag, not a simple X: X means vacation, L means remunerated leave. They map to two DIFFERENT electronic payroll blocks - VacacionesComunes (NIE109 to NIE112) and LicenciaR (NIE132 to NIE135) respectively - so the value carries real information and must not be normalised to X.

fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event flag. Blank or X. May be reported ONLY where the contributor appears with S in campo 5 of the operador's file 'INFORMACIÓN DE LA AFILIACIÓN A PENSIONES'. Where marked, campos 48 and 49 (member and employer voluntary contributions) become relevant. Bidirectional set with T2R2-048 and T2R2-049. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) campo 28.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_AVP [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: Signals that a voluntary pension contribution is included in this settlement.

fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Where marked, 'VCT start date' (T2R2-091) and 'VCT end date' (T2R2-092) become mandatory, and 'Work centre' (T2R2-062) changes. Bidirectional set with T2R2-091, T2R2-092 and T2R2-062.
fields.Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_VCT [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: Change of work centre during the period. It matters because THE OCCUPATIONAL-RISK CLASS ATTACHES TO THE WORK CENTRE, NOT TO THE EMPLOYER (Decree 1072 of 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.5.6), so a move can change the ARL rate mid-period.

fields.Field Name (EN): IRL - days of occupational accident or disease incapacity
fields.Field Name (Local ES): IRL: Dias de incapacidad por accidente de trabajo o enfermedad laboral.
fields.Conditional Reason: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Zero, or a day count between 01 and 30. Where non-zero, 'IRL start date' (T2R2-093) and 'IRL end date' (T2R2-094) become mandatory. Bidirectional set with T2R2-093 and T2R2-094.
fields.Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Novedad_IRL_Days [Not an amount field -- a PILA novedad (change-event) code; no WTC code applies by design]
fields.Field Explanation: UNLIKE THE OTHER CHANGE EVENT FLAGS THIS ONE CARRIES A NUMBER, not an X: it is the count of days of incapacity arising from an occupational accident or disease, funded by the ARL from day one at 100%. Maps to electronic payroll Incapacity with Tipo = 2 or 3.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Codigo de la administradora de fondos de pensiones a la cual pertenece el afiliado
fields.Conditional Reason: Mandatory in general. Blank is permitted ONLY where 'Contributor type' (T2R2-005) or 'Contributor sub-type' (T2R2-006) is one that is not obliged to contribute to the Sistema General de Pensiones. Bidirectional set with T2R2-005 and T2R2-006. Also bidirectional with the 'TDP - transfer from another pension administrator' change event (T2R2-019), which reports the move between administrators that changes the value carried here.
fields.Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right. Prefix pattern ^(ARL|EPS|EOC|AFP|CCF|FSP)[0-9]{3}$ - THREE alphabetic positions identifying the subsystem followed by THREE numeric positions identifying the administradora. Verified against the PILA anexo, which names FSP001, MIN001 and MIN002 in running prose. The code LIST itself is master data published by the Ministerio de Salud y Proteccion Social; validate the prefix here and the code against the catalogue
fields.Field Explanation: Code of the pension administrator - either Colpensiones in the average-premium regime or a private individual-account fund. The employee elects the regime and may change it every five years.

fields.Field Name (EN): Pension fund to which the member transfers

fields.Conditional Reason: Must be reported BLANK ('Debe reportarse en blanco', AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) campo 32).
fields.Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right. fields.Field Explanation: Code of the health insurer. Health is the subsystem paid one month in advance, per T2R1-016. Bidirectional pair with the 'TDE - transfer from another EPS' change event (T2R2-017), which reports the move between health insurers that changes the value carried here.

fields.Field Name (EN): EPS or EOC to which the member transfers
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Codigo EPS o EOC a la cual se traslada el afiliado
fields.Conditional Reason: Must be reported BLANK ('Debe reportarse en blanco', AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) campo 34).
fields.Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right. Prefix pattern ^(ARL|EPS|EOC|AFP|CCF|FSP)[0-9]{3}$ - THREE alphabetic positions identifying the subsystem followed by THREE numeric positions identifying the administradora. fields.Field Explanation: Destination health insurer on a transfer.
